records.description: A `Tensor` of type `string`. Each string is a record/row in the csv and all records should have the same format.

record_defaults.description: A list of `Tensor` objects with specific types. Acceptable types are `float32`, `float64`, `int32`, `int64`, `string`. One tensor per column of the input record, with either a scalar default value for that column or an empty vector if the column is required.
constraints: record_defaults must be one of float32, float64, int32, int64, string

field_delim.description: An optional `string`. Defaults to `","`. char delimiter to separate fields in a record.

use_quote_delim.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `True`. If false, treats double quotation marks as regular characters inside of the string fields (ignoring RFC 4180, Section 2, Bullet 5).

na_value.description: Additional string to recognize as NA/NaN.

select_cols.description: Optional sorted list of column indices to select. If specified, only this subset of columns will be parsed and returned. It only works on `records` except for `record_defaults`.

output.description: A list of `Tensor` objects. Has the same type as `record_defaults`. Each tensor will have the same shape as records.
